tagline.en: Dexmal's vision-language-action policy — a Qwen3-based flow action expert that turns multi-view observations into robot action chunks.
tagline.zh: Dexmal 的视觉-语言-动作策略——基于 Qwen3 的 flow action expert,把多视角观测转化为机器人动作序列。

en: DM0 is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from Dexmal, part of the Dexbotic effort. It takes what a robot sees and the instruction it is given, and predicts the actions the robot should execute.

The policy pairs a multimodal perception and language backbone with a Qwen3-based flow action expert. It consumes several camera views plus the robot's proprioceptive state and emits a chunk of future actions in one pass, rather than a single step at a time. Two checkpoints are available on Hugging Face: a base model and a LIBERO-oriented variant.
In WorldFoundry, DM0 runs in-process from local checkpoints — you provide the camera views and state vector, and it returns an action chunk you can feed to a controller or simulator.
zh: DM0 是 Dexmal(Dexbotic 项目)推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它接收机器人所看到的画面与收到的指令,预测机器人应当执行的动作。
该策略把多模态感知与语言主干,同一个基于 Qwen3 的 flow action expert 结合起来。它一次性接收多个相机视角加上机器人的本体状态,直接输出一段未来动作序列,而不是逐步预测单个动作。Hugging Face 上提供两个 checkpoint:一个基座模型,以及一个面向 LIBERO 的变体。
在 WorldFoundry 中,DM0 直接从本地 checkpoint 在进程内运行——你提供相机视角与状态向量,它就返回一段可交给控制器或仿真器执行的动作序列。

whenToUse.en: Reach for DM0 when you need a multi-view VLA policy that maps camera observations and an instruction directly to executable robot actions, or when you want a LIBERO-oriented starting point to build on.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个多视角 VLA 策略、把相机观测与指令直接映射为可执行的机器人动作,或想要一个面向 LIBERO 的起点时,可以选择 DM0。

notFor.en: This is an action policy, not a video or image generator. Checkpoints are downloaded separately, so plan for the download and the compatible robot setup you intend to control.
notFor.zh: 它是动作策略,而非视频或图像生成器。Checkpoint 需单独下载,请预留下载时间,并准备好你打算控制的兼容机器人配置。
